assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9)

Due to the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need to correlate arrhythmic events with neurological deficits, long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to establish a definitive diagnosis and guide management
The physician ordered CPT 93247, a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
The service is medically necessary to address the member's documented clinical condition
